title: Flux Cognitive Engine LX 8
description: Llama 3.1 405B — open-weight language model is the nominative anchor for this record. The Flux Cognitive Engine LX 8 carries the same working details — 405 billion parameters released as open weights — rendered as a fully original Signature work. It reached the market in 2024, aimed at developers and researchers.
